_doc: Stream E (play-test 2, Q28). A low-level class quest for each of the 30 Farhold classes and (wrap-up 2026-10-13) Thousandvale's own Starcaller and (round 11, #53) Star Blade, merged into zone 'test' (the Torbor Fields) via test.json `include`. `npcs` are the class trainers (role 'trainer', `trains` = class ids; `at` = a set piece id from data/vignettes/setpieces.json, or Torborhold with an `office` kind resolved by data/provinces/offices.json). A quest with `classes` is offered only to those classes. Rewards: `item` {tier, slot, base (items.json base key), name (bespoke)}; `unlock: 'companion'` (rules.unlock: the class companion now instead of level 10) for the 13 companion classes; `perks: 1` (one extra perk-forest point) for the other 17. `rewardText` = the player-facing summary. S10 (play-test 4): `needsGiver: true` on the quests whose trainer hands you a companion — those are turned in in person; every other quest pays itself where you finish it (remote turn-in).

trainer_arms.name: Sergeant-at-Arms Brede Holloway
trainer_arms.greeting: Feet apart. No, YOUR feet. Good. Now we can talk.
says: Again! Like you mean it this time.
The dummy has won four bouts this week. Don't make it five.
Sweat is free. Blood costs extra.

trainer_holy.name: Mother Ansel
trainer_holy.greeting: The light finds everyone eventually. It finds some of us with a stick.
says: Kneel if you like. The floor is cleaner than it looks.
Prayer, then porridge. That is the order of things.
Mind the candles. They have opinions.

trainer_arcane.name: Magister Pellam Voss
trainer_arcane.greeting: Don't touch that. Or that. Especially not that one, it bites.
says: The scorch marks are load-bearing, leave them.
Magic is just arithmetic that shouts.
If my eyebrows grow back, I'll have won.
If one more star lands in my cabbages, I am sending the bill to the sky.
Star Blades keep asking to borrow my whetstone. Starlight does not need sharpening. Starlight needs SHIELDING.

trainer_shadow.name: Sly Mabry
trainer_shadow.greeting: You didn't see me. Good. Practise that on other people.
says: Pockets are just boxes people forget to lock.
Walk soft. The floorboards are on the reeve's side.
Everything has a price. Mine is reasonable.

trainer_runes.name: Garrick Stonehand
trainer_runes.greeting: A rune is a promise you hit into iron. Break it and the iron keeps it.
says: Tap, tap, listen. The metal tells you where.
Don't sneeze near wet ink.
My hammer's older than the town.

trainer_hunt.name: Oswy Greyfletch
trainer_hunt.greeting: Quiet. You're upwind and you smell like town.
says: Tracks don't lie. People do.
Every arrow you lose is a lesson you paid for.
The wood's watching. So am I.

trainer_wilds.name: Wenna of the Stones
trainer_wilds.greeting: The stones counted you coming up the hill. You're one more than they expected.
says: Nine maidens, one fiddler, and a very long dance.
Bare feet on the grass. It listens better that way.
The spirits are chatty today. Mostly about you.

trainer_grave.name: Old Mother Quell
trainer_grave.greeting: Forty years I've dug these holes. Some of them have started digging back.
says: Mind the soft patch. That's Gaffer Wat.
Everyone ends up here. Some of us just visit early.
A spade is a very honest tool.

trainer_pact.name: Ysolde Coldharrow
trainer_pact.greeting: My family burned this house down with a bargain. I kept the bargain.
says: Everything costs. I just read the price first.
The ash still whispers, if you lean close.
Bleed a little. It clears the head.

trainer_mind.name: Brother Cadoc
trainer_mind.greeting: You were going to say hello. I saved you the trouble.
says: Stand on one leg. Now the other. Now neither.
The road south is long. So is patience.
I dreamed you'd come. You were taller.

trainer_tinker.name: Jory Millward
trainer_tinker.greeting: Gears, cogs, springs, a little swearing. That's how the mill turns.
says: If it squeaks, oil it. If it explodes, write it down.
The wheel never stops. I wish I could say the same.
Hand me that. No, the other that.

trainer_bard.name: Lute-master Emrys Fenwick
trainer_bard.greeting: Sit, sit. Every road ends in a song, if you wait long enough.
says: This next one's about a goat. They're all about a goat.
Tune your strings and your temper.
Applause is accepted in coin.

quests.name: The Dummy Wins Again
quests.offer: That straw dummy has knocked three recruits flat this week. I don't know how. Nobody knows how. Beat it, then go and beat something that bites back — warriors get stronger the more there are around them.

steps.text: Strike the straw dummy at the Drill Field
steps.where: Torbor Drill Field, just outside Torborhold's gate

steps.text: Kill 6 moor hounds on the grass round the Drill Field
steps.where: the open grass round the Drill Field

steps.text: Hang your blade on the weapon rack to show you came back
steps.where: Torbor Drill Field, just outside Torborhold's gate

quests.done: Six at once? No? Well, it'll be six at once soon. The rack's yours to use, and so's this. Take a perk point while you're at it — you've earned the knack of standing in a crowd.
quests.rewardText: A rare longsword, Holloway's Second-Best Longsword, and one extra perk-forest point.

quests.name: Stance and Answer
quests.offer: Fighters don't flail. Fighters answer. The brigands squatting in Coldharrow Ruins swing first and think later. Hold your guard on the collapsed stair, then answer every swing they throw — a counter for every blow.

steps.text: Hold your stance on the collapsed stair at Coldharrow Ruins
steps.where: Coldharrow Ruins, the burnt manor in the fields

steps.text: Defeat 5 road brigands at Coldharrow Ruins
steps.where: Coldharrow Ruins, the burnt manor in the fields

steps.text: Take 3 notched blades as proof
steps.where: Coldharrow Ruins, the burnt manor in the fields

quests.done: Notched on the edge, clean on the flat. You let them hit the blade, not you. That's the whole trade. Here — a proper two-hander, and a perk point for the lesson.
quests.rewardText: A rare two-handed sword, The Patient Answer, and one extra perk-forest point.

quests.name: The Oath at the Bell
quests.offer: A knight stands between the weak and whatever wants them. Old Mother Quell at Saint Hulda's says the dead hounds come for the mourners. Ring her bell, stand your ground, and take the hits so nobody else has to.

steps.text: Ring the sexton's bell at Saint Hulda's Yard
steps.where: Saint Hulda's Yard, the graveyard outside Torborhold

steps.text: Hold the yard against 5 barrow hounds
steps.where: Saint Hulda's Yard, the graveyard outside Torborhold

steps.text: Tell Old Mother Quell the mourners are safe
steps.where: Saint Hulda's Yard, the graveyard outside Torborhold

quests.done: Quell says you stood like a gatepost. That's the highest praise she gives anything alive. A shield fit for the oath, and a perk point.
quests.rewardText: A rare kite shield, Gatepost Shield, and one extra perk-forest point.

quests.name: Flair for the Dramatic
quests.offer: Anyone can win a fight. A swashbuckler wins it with style, a different trick each time. Go to the Pail and Plough, pin your challenge on the notice post, then prove it on the boars in the fields behind the inn. With FLOURISH. Then come in and boast about it from the hearth.

steps.text: Pin your challenge to the notice post at the Pail and Plough
steps.where: The Pail and Plough, the crossroads inn on the Orrinsford road

steps.text: Defeat 5 thicket boars in the fields behind the inn — stylishly
steps.where: the fields behind the Pail and Plough

steps.text: Boast from the hearth at the Pail and Plough
steps.where: The Pail and Plough, the crossroads inn on the Orrinsford road

quests.done: The whole inn clapped. Well, two of them did, and one was asleep. Close enough. A rapier with a little bit of swagger in the blade, and a perk point.
quests.rewardText: A rare rapier, Scarecrow's Applause, and one extra perk-forest point.

quests.name: Temper the Scale
quests.offer: A dragon knight picks a temper — fire, frost or storm — and the wyrm's heart answers. You'll need heat to wake yours. The lumber camp's grindstone sparks, and the teeth of its big saw spark more. Put an edge on your blade at both, then blood it on the flitters in the woods.

steps.text: Strike sparks off the big saw in the saw pit at Ashby's Lumber Camp
steps.where: Ashby's Lumber Camp, at the edge of the woods

steps.text: Spark the grindstone at Ashby's Lumber Camp
steps.where: Ashby's Lumber Camp, at the edge of the woods

steps.text: Kill 6 dusk flitters around the lumber camp
steps.where: Ashby's Lumber Camp, at the edge of the woods

quests.done: Feel that? Warm, like a coal in your chest. That's the wyrm, stirring. A greatsword that likes the heat, and a perk point for waking it.
quests.rewardText: A rare greatsword, Wyrmwaker, and one extra perk-forest point.

quests.name: Orders for the Boars
quests.offer: A tactician wins the fight before it starts. Study the planting at Brannock Fields — the boars come by the same path every dusk. Give the order: thin the herd, then plant your banner on the scarecrow so the field knows it has a general.

steps.text: Survey Brannock Fields
steps.where: Brannock Fields, the farmland near Torborhold

steps.text: Move the beehives across the boars' path
steps.where: Brannock Fields, the farmland near Torborhold

steps.text: Defeat 4 thicket boars as they blunder into the bees
steps.where: Brannock Fields, the farmland near Torborhold

steps.text: Plant your banner on the scarecrow
steps.where: Brannock Fields, the farmland near Torborhold

quests.done: Bees. You used BEES. That's not in any manual I own, which means I'm writing one. A sword for the field commander, and a perk point.
quests.rewardText: A rare sword, The Beekeeper's Order, and one extra perk-forest point.

quests.name: Bandages for the Living
quests.offer: A cleric's heal doesn't stop at full — it overflows into a shield. Practise on someone who needs it: the Kind Mother's pilgrims come in muddy and bruised. Pray at her shrine, take river reed off the fen frogs round it for splints, and lay the splints at her statue for whoever needs them.

steps.text: Pray at the Shrine of the Kind Mother
steps.where: Shrine of the Kind Mother, beside the south road

steps.text: Gather 5 bundles of river reed from fen croakers by the shrine
steps.where: the wet ground round the Shrine of the Kind Mother

steps.text: Lay the reed splints at the Mother's statue
steps.where: Shrine of the Kind Mother, beside the south road

quests.done: Reed splints and a prayer. That's half of medicine, and the other half is shouting at people to sit still. A scepter blessed at the shrine, and a perk point.
quests.rewardText: A rare scepter, Bryn's Steady Hand, and one extra perk-forest point.

quests.name: A Debt to the Dead
quests.offer: Priests pay for revivals in advance and collect from killers afterwards. Saint Hulda's ossuary door has been forced — someone robbed the dead. Find the brigands with the grave rings, and mark every one of them.

steps.text: Inspect the forced ossuary door at Saint Hulda's Yard
steps.where: Saint Hulda's Yard, the graveyard outside Torborhold

steps.text: Take back 4 stolen grave rings from the road brigands camped near the yard
steps.where: the brigands camped near Saint Hulda's Yard

steps.text: Return the rings to the open grave
steps.where: Saint Hulda's Yard, the graveyard outside Torborhold

quests.done: The dead are paid back, and the robbers paid up. That is the whole of my faith in one afternoon. A mace that never forgets who it struck — and a spirit bear walks with you from today.
quests.rewardText: A rare mace, Ledger of the Unquiet, and your companion comes to you now instead of at level 10.

quests.name: Strike and Heal
quests.offer: A paladin heals by hitting. Strange, but it works. Brigands have made a den of the Coldharrow ruins and daubed their mark on the old manor. Drive them out — every blow you land is a prayer — then bless the ruin so nothing camps there again.

steps.text: Drive out 6 road brigands from Coldharrow Ruins
steps.where: Coldharrow Ruins, the burnt manor in the fields

steps.text: Smash the brigands' cracked sigil
steps.where: Coldharrow Ruins, the burnt manor in the fields

steps.text: Bless the collapsed stair so the ruin stays clean
steps.where: Coldharrow Ruins, the burnt manor in the fields

quests.done: The ruin is quiet, and it will stay quiet. You hit things until they were holy. That's the order, more or less. A sword with a little light in it, and a perk point.
quests.rewardText: A rare sword, Kind Mother's Edge, and one extra perk-forest point.

quests.name: Frost Then Shatter
quests.offer: Frost slows, and a slowed thing shatters. Lesson one. Lesson two: never practise indoors, my ceiling has suffered. Chill the water at Tench Pool, then shatter the frogs that come to complain.

steps.text: Freeze the shallows from the old jetty at Tench Pool
steps.where: Tench Pool, the fishing spot near Torborhold

steps.text: Shatter 6 fen croakers around Tench Pool
steps.where: Tench Pool, the fishing spot near Torborhold

steps.text: Collect 3 frost-cracked frog stones
steps.where: Tench Pool, the fishing spot near Torborhold

quests.done: Lovely little cracks. You can see the cold went right through. A staff, still cold at the tip, and a perk point.
quests.rewardText: A rare staff, Voss's Icebound Rod, and one extra perk-forest point.

quests.name: Wild Results
quests.offer: Sorcery is chance with a loud voice. Your bolts will roll their own element. Fine. Go to the Nine Maidens and let the stones decide what you are today, then test whatever comes out on the boars on the slope below.

steps.text: Lay your hand on the altar stone at the Nine Maidens
steps.where: The Nine Maidens, a ring of standing stones on the hill

steps.text: Test your wild bolts on 5 thicket boars below the stones
steps.where: the slope below the Nine Maidens

steps.text: Tell the heel stone how it went
steps.where: The Nine Maidens, a ring of standing stones on the hill

quests.done: Fire, then frost, then something purple? Excellent. Nobody, including you, knows what's next. A wand to steer it, a little — and a storm familiar now answers your call.
quests.rewardText: A rare wand, The Coin-Toss Wand, and your companion comes to you now instead of at level 10.

quests.name: The Mill Runs Backwards
quests.offer: Jory at the mill swears the wheel turned backwards for a whole minute last night. It did. I did it. By accident. Go and wind the gears forward again, then catch the rats that got stuck in yesterday.

steps.text: Ask Jory Millward about the backwards wheel
steps.where: Turnwater Mill, on the stream near Torborhold

steps.text: Wind the gear housing forward
steps.where: Turnwater Mill, on the stream near Torborhold

steps.text: Clear 6 cairn rats stuck in yesterday
steps.where: Turnwater Mill, on the stream near Torborhold

steps.text: Pull the sluice lever at exactly the right moment
steps.where: Turnwater Mill, on the stream near Torborhold

quests.done: The wheel's turning the right way, and the rats are gone from all three of their days. Don't tell Jory. A staff that ticks if you hold it close, and a perk point.
quests.rewardText: A rare staff, Yesterday's Staff, and one extra perk-forest point.

quests.name: Sleep, Little Hounds
quests.offer: An enchanter picks her fights by putting the others to sleep. The hounds have been worrying Brannock Fields. Lull them, deal with the ones that won't nap, then hum the bees to sleep — and see if you can make the scarecrow's crows nod off too. I'm curious.

steps.text: Deal with 5 moor hounds round Brannock Fields that will not sleep
steps.where: the grass round Brannock Fields

steps.text: Hum the bees to sleep at Brannock Fields
steps.where: Brannock Fields, the farmland near Torborhold

steps.text: Lull the crows on the scarecrow to sleep
steps.where: Brannock Fields, the farmland near Torborhold

quests.done: The crows are asleep. Crows have never been asleep. You're better than you think. Robes that hum softly, and a bound imp now does as you ask.
quests.rewardText: A rare robe, Lullaby Robes, and your companion comes to you now instead of at level 10.

quests.name: Conductors
quests.offer: Lightning jumps between conductors. Wet things conduct. Tench Pool is wet, the frogs are wet, and the old jetty is very, very wet. Do the arithmetic.

steps.text: Sink the iron fish traps at Tench Pool as conductors
steps.where: Tench Pool, the fishing spot near Torborhold

steps.text: Chain lightning through 7 fen croakers
steps.where: Tench Pool, the fishing spot near Torborhold

steps.text: Ground yourself on the rod rack before you light up
steps.where: Tench Pool, the fishing spot near Torborhold

quests.done: Seven frogs in one bolt? I counted four. Either way. A wand that crackles in the rain — and a storm familiar is yours from today.
quests.rewardText: A rare wand, Pondstrike Wand, and your companion comes to you now instead of at level 10.

quests.name: Kindling
quests.offer: Burns stack. Two is worse than one, three is worse than that. Ashby's lumber camp has a dusk flitter problem and a great deal of dry wood. Please burn the flitters. Please do not burn the wood.

steps.text: Go to Ashby's Lumber Camp
steps.where: Ashby's Lumber Camp, at the edge of the woods

steps.text: Stack burns on 6 dusk flitters
steps.where: Ashby's Lumber Camp, at the edge of the woods

steps.text: Check the log pile is NOT on fire
steps.where: Ashby's Lumber Camp, at the edge of the woods

quests.done: Not on fire! Remarkable restraint. A scepter that's always a little warm — and a small fire familiar wakes for you now.
quests.rewardText: A rare scepter, Restraint of Ashby, and your companion comes to you now instead of at level 10.

quests.name: Nine Stones, Nine Stars
quests.offer: The old folk stood nine stones in a ring to mark where the stars come down. You throw stars for a living, so go and check. Sight the evening star over the heel stone, then fill your Constellation on the dusk flitters that roost round the stones.

steps.text: Sight the evening star over the heel stone at the Nine Maidens
steps.where: The Nine Maidens, a ring of standing stones on the hill

steps.text: Bring down 6 dusk flitters round the stones with thrown stars
steps.where: The Nine Maidens, a ring of standing stones on the hill

steps.text: Chalk where your stars fell on the altar stone
steps.where: The Nine Maidens, a ring of standing stones on the hill

quests.done: Six flitters, and the altar stone still in one piece? Then you were aiming. A wand that points at the sky when nobody is holding it, and a perk point.
quests.rewardText: A rare wand, Wand of the Ninth Star, and one extra perk-forest point.

quests.name: Steel by Starlight
quests.offer: A Star Blade's sword is only steel until the sky has had a look at it. Go up to the Nine Maidens — it is all up there, you will not have to walk back and forth. Lay your blade on the altar stone, let the boars on the hill find out what a star shield does when they charge it, then hold the blade up at the heel stone and see if the evening star sits on its point.

steps.text: Lay your blade on the altar stone at the Nine Maidens
steps.where: The Nine Maidens, a ring of standing stones on the hill

steps.text: Turn 5 thicket boars on your star shield, just below the stones
steps.where: The slope under the Nine Maidens

steps.text: Hold the blade up at the heel stone until the evening star sits on its point
steps.where: The Nine Maidens, a ring of standing stones on the hill

quests.done: Five boars and not a scratch through the shield? The star took to the blade, then. Here — a sword that was waiting for someone like you, and a perk point.
quests.rewardText: A rare longsword, Edge of the Evening Star, and one extra perk-forest point.

quests.name: Set Up, Cash In
quests.offer: Rogues set up the hit, then cash it in. Easy. Somebody has a strongbox hidden in Coldharrow Ruins — I'd like to know what's in it before they do. Poison the brigands guarding it, then take a peek.

steps.text: Scout Coldharrow Ruins without being seen
steps.where: Coldharrow Ruins, the burnt manor in the fields

steps.text: Take down 5 road brigands at Coldharrow
steps.where: Coldharrow Ruins, the burnt manor in the fields

steps.text: Search under the collapsed stair
steps.where: Coldharrow Ruins, the burnt manor in the fields

quests.done: Empty! Somebody beat us to it. That's fine. You found the stair, they'll come back to it, and we'll be waiting. A dagger that's never been seen in daylight, and a perk point.
quests.rewardText: A rare dagger, Mabry's Quiet Thanks, and one extra perk-forest point.

quests.name: Afterimages
quests.offer: A shadow dancer leaves a copy of herself behind and is somewhere else. Practise on Old Mother Quell: slip into her ossuary without being seen, cut down the hounds in the yard, then ring her own bell behind her back and be gone before she turns round.

steps.text: Slip through the ossuary door unseen
steps.where: Saint Hulda's Yard, the graveyard outside Torborhold

steps.text: Cut down 5 barrow hounds without being caught
steps.where: Saint Hulda's Yard, the graveyard outside Torborhold

steps.text: Ring the sexton's bell behind Quell's back, then vanish
steps.where: Saint Hulda's Yard, the graveyard outside Torborhold

quests.done: Quell says she's been haunted all afternoon. Perfect. A dagger with no shine at all, and a perk point.
quests.rewardText: A rare dagger, Quell's Missing Hour, and one extra perk-forest point.

quests.name: Lucky Finds
quests.offer: Scavengers live on luck. Luck is mostly looking where other people don't. Rummage round Turnwater Mill: under the millstone, behind the gear housing, in the sluice box. Something good is always lying about — and the rats have been at it first.

steps.text: Rummage under the millstone at Turnwater Mill
steps.where: Turnwater Mill, on the stream near Torborhold

steps.text: Poke about behind the gear housing
steps.where: Turnwater Mill, on the stream near Torborhold

steps.text: Check the box under the sluice lever
steps.where: Turnwater Mill, on the stream near Torborhold

steps.text: Find 3 lucky trinkets in the nests of cairn rats
steps.where: Turnwater Mill, on the stream near Torborhold

quests.done: A button, a tooth and a very old coin. Lucky trinkets, every one. Keep the coin. A javelin I found the same way, and a perk point.
quests.rewardText: A rare javelin, Finders-Keepers, and one extra perk-forest point.

quests.name: A Rune That Holds
quests.offer: A rune is struck, not drawn. You need a stone that's heard a lot and said nothing. The heel stone at the Nine Maidens has been listening for a thousand years. Take a rubbing, temper it on the altar stone, then test it on hide.

steps.text: Take a rubbing from the heel stone at the Nine Maidens
steps.where: The Nine Maidens, a ring of standing stones on the hill

steps.text: Temper your rune on the altar stone
steps.where: The Nine Maidens, a ring of standing stones on the hill

steps.text: Test your rune hammer on 5 thicket boars below the stones
steps.where: the slope below the Nine Maidens

quests.done: It held. Five boars and not a crack. You're a runesmith now, heaven help the anvils. A hammer with my mark under yours, and a perk point.
quests.rewardText: A rare warhammer, Stonehand's Pupil, and one extra perk-forest point.

quests.name: The Hunt
quests.offer: A ranger's whole life is the hunt. Hit the butts at the drill field so I know you can shoot, then bring me hides from the hounds on the grass round it and hang them on the rack to dry. Do it well and I'll whistle up the cat.

steps.text: Put three arrows in the archery butts at the Drill Field
steps.where: Torbor Drill Field, just outside Torborhold's gate

steps.text: Bring 5 moor hound hides from the grass round the Drill Field
steps.where: the open grass round the Drill Field

steps.text: Hang the hides on the weapon rack to dry
steps.where: Torbor Drill Field, just outside Torborhold's gate

quests.done: Clean hides, clean shots. You'll do. Here's a bow from my own rack — and hear that rustle? Your hunting cat's found you.
quests.rewardText: A rare shortbow, Greyfletch's Promise, and your companion comes to you now instead of at level 10.

quests.name: Silver and Salt
quests.offer: Something at the Nine Maidens is souring the milk for three villages. A witch hunter strips magic off whatever wears it. Silver your edge on the old iron bands of the heel stone, then go and see what dances in the mushroom ring.

steps.text: Scrape silver off the old iron bands on the heel stone
steps.where: The Nine Maidens, a ring of standing stones on the hill

steps.text: Break the ring of mushrooms at the Nine Maidens
steps.where: The Nine Maidens, a ring of standing stones on the hill

steps.text: Purge 4 bog slimes that crawl out of the soured ground by the stones
steps.where: the soured ground round the Nine Maidens

quests.done: Slime. It was SLIME. Magic slime, granted. The milk's sweet again. A crossbow with a silver-tipped bolt in the groove, and a perk point.
quests.rewardText: A rare crossbow, Milk-Sweetener, and one extra perk-forest point.

quests.name: Hold a Grudge
quests.offer: A demon hunter's strength is a grudge, carried and fed. Gristle's hollow killed my brother's dog. I want that grudge carried by someone with younger knees. Feed it on the hounds, then dig the old dog's collar out of their bone heap.

steps.text: Find Gristle's Hollow
steps.where: Gristle's Hollow, a hound den past Greyfletch Camp

steps.text: Kill 6 moor hounds around Gristle's Hollow
steps.where: Gristle's Hollow, a hound den past Greyfletch Camp

steps.text: Find the old dog's collar in the bone heap
steps.where: Gristle's Hollow, a hound den past Greyfletch Camp

quests.done: My brother will cry, and then he'll buy you a drink. A crossbow for the long grudge — and your dire hound comes to heel today.
quests.rewardText: A rare crossbow, Brother's Grudge, and your companion comes to you now instead of at level 10.

quests.name: Wearing Another Shape
quests.offer: A druid borrows shapes. To borrow, you must first understand. Sit with the bees at Brannock, stand as still as the scarecrow until the crows forget you, then run with the boars — not after them, WITH them, until you've learned how they think. Then thin them a little.

steps.text: Sit with the beehives at Brannock Fields
steps.where: Brannock Fields, the farmland near Torborhold

steps.text: Stand as still as the scarecrow until the crows forget you
steps.where: Brannock Fields, the farmland near Torborhold

steps.text: Run with the boars, then thin the herd by 4
steps.where: Brannock Fields, the farmland near Torborhold

quests.done: You came back smelling of honey and pig. That's the right smell. A staff grown, not cut — and two grove wolves have decided you're theirs.
quests.rewardText: A rare quarterstaff, Rootgrown Staff, and your companion comes to you now instead of at level 10.

quests.name: Posts for the Spirits
quests.offer: Shamans plant posts and the spirits gather to them. Tench Pool has posts enough: the stakes of the fish traps, the jetty, the rod rack. Ask the spirits at each, and drive off the frogs that keep knocking them over.

steps.text: Choose a post from the fish traps' stakes at Tench Pool
steps.where: Tench Pool, the fishing spot near Torborhold

steps.text: Plant a spirit post on the old jetty
steps.where: Tench Pool, the fishing spot near Torborhold

steps.text: Drive off 5 fen croakers from the jetty
steps.where: Tench Pool, the fishing spot near Torborhold

steps.text: Carve a spirit mark on the rod rack
steps.where: Tench Pool, the fishing spot near Torborhold

quests.done: Three posts and three happy spirits. One of them is a bear. The bear is coming with you. A scepter carved from the trap stake, and the spirit bear walks at your side now.
quests.rewardText: A rare scepter, The Bear's Post, and your companion comes to you now instead of at level 10.

quests.name: Good Bones
quests.offer: You want corpses that get back up. I want corpses that stay down. We can help each other. The barrow hounds dig up my yard — kill them, collect their grave dust, and wake one of them in the open grave so I can see how it's done.

steps.text: Kill 5 barrow hounds digging in Saint Hulda's Yard
steps.where: Saint Hulda's Yard, the graveyard outside Torborhold

steps.text: Gather 4 pinches of grave dust
steps.where: Saint Hulda's Yard, the graveyard outside Torborhold

steps.text: Sprinkle the dust in the open grave
steps.where: Saint Hulda's Yard, the graveyard outside Torborhold

quests.done: It sat up, said something rude, and lay down again. Promising. A staff with a knuckle-bone on top — and two bone thralls have climbed out to follow you.
quests.rewardText: A rare staff, Quell's Good Spade, and your companion comes to you now instead of at level 10.

quests.name: Health as Fuel
quests.offer: Warlocks burn their own health to feed the dark. It's cheaper than it sounds. My grandfather sealed a bargain in that cracked sigil. Bleed on it, then finish what he started on the brigands who squat in his hall.

steps.text: Bleed on the cracked sigil at Coldharrow Ruins
steps.where: Coldharrow Ruins, the burnt manor in the fields

steps.text: Burn out 6 road brigands from Coldharrow
steps.where: Coldharrow Ruins, the burnt manor in the fields

steps.text: Leave an offering under the collapsed stair
steps.where: Coldharrow Ruins, the burnt manor in the fields

quests.done: Something under the stair said thank you. Don't answer it. A wand that drinks a little — and a bound imp has signed itself over to you.
quests.rewardText: A rare wand, Coldharrow's Bargain, and your companion comes to you now instead of at level 10.

quests.name: Poise
quests.offer: A monk is poise. Stand on the prayer stones until the road stops wobbling. Then go out among the hounds and keep that stillness while everything around you snaps and howls.

steps.text: Balance on the prayer stones at the Shrine of the Kind Mother
steps.where: Shrine of the Kind Mother, beside the south road

steps.text: Keep your poise against 6 moor hounds round the shrine
steps.where: the grass round the Shrine of the Kind Mother

steps.text: Leave your empty hands in the offering bowl
steps.where: Shrine of the Kind Mother, beside the south road

quests.done: Empty hands, full heart, very muddy knees. That's monkhood. A staff to lean on, never to rely on, and a perk point.
quests.rewardText: A rare quarterstaff, Stillwater Staff, and one extra perk-forest point.

quests.name: Foresight
quests.offer: I saw you in a dream, killing boars in a field beside an inn. It must happen now or my dream was a liar. First read the omens at the well and the hearth of the Pail and Plough. Then go out the back and make my dream honest.

steps.text: Read the omen in the well at the Pail and Plough
steps.where: The Pail and Plough, the crossroads inn on the Orrinsford road

steps.text: Read the ashes in the inn's hearth
steps.where: The Pail and Plough, the crossroads inn on the Orrinsford road

steps.text: Fulfil the dream: kill 5 thicket boars in the fields behind the inn
steps.where: the fields behind the Pail and Plough

quests.done: Exactly as dreamed. Except the hat. You weren't wearing a hat in my dream. A scepter for seeing a little further — and a small bright familiar wakes at your shoulder.
quests.rewardText: A rare scepter, The Honest Dream, and your companion comes to you now instead of at level 10.

quests.name: Gadgets
quests.offer: Gadgets! The mill's full of spare parts and rats who steal them. Fetch back my springs from the rat nests, fit them in the gear housing, and we'll wind up a little friend for you.

steps.text: Recover 5 stolen springs from cairn rats
steps.where: Turnwater Mill, on the stream near Torborhold

steps.text: Fit the springs into the gear housing
steps.where: Turnwater Mill, on the stream near Torborhold

steps.text: Pull the sluice lever to test it
steps.where: Turnwater Mill, on the stream near Torborhold

quests.done: It ticks! It walks! It shot the miller's hat! A crossbow with a crank on the side — and your clockwork sentry is wound and ready.
quests.rewardText: A rare crossbow, Millward's Crank-Bow, and your companion comes to you now instead of at level 10.

quests.name: A Song for the Pail
quests.offer: A bard's songs make the party better and the enemy worse. But first, a song needs a story. The Pail and Plough has no song of its own. Go and find one: sweet water from the well, a hound's howl from the fields, a farmer's grumble off the notice post. Then sing it by the hearth.

steps.text: Taste the water from the inn's well
steps.where: The Pail and Plough, the crossroads inn on the Orrinsford road

steps.text: Make 4 moor hounds in the fields round the inn howl their last verse
steps.where: the fields round the Pail and Plough

steps.text: Copy a farmer's grumble off the notice post for the chorus
steps.where: The Pail and Plough, the crossroads inn on the Orrinsford road

steps.text: Sing the new song at the hearth
steps.where: The Pail and Plough, the crossroads inn on the Orrinsford road

quests.done: Nobody threw anything! A triumph. A dagger for when the song ends badly, and a perk point.
quests.rewardText: A rare dagger, Pail and Plough Ballad, and one extra perk-forest point.
